tasbih-counter.title: Online Tasbeeh Counter | Digital Tasbeeh, Masnoon Duas and Wazaif | Mufeed Tools
tasbih-counter.description: Free digital tasbeeh counter for your phone: 33, 99, 100 or free target, today's total and a keep-screen-awake option. With masnoon duas and their sources.
tasbih-counter.lead: Keep tapping and the count rises by itself. Choose a target of 33, 99, 100 or free. Your count stays only on your phone.
tasbih-counter.note: The count is saved in your browser only. The keep-screen-awake button does not work on every phone.
tasbih-counter.duasIntro: A few well-known masnoon duas with meaning and source. To confirm the Arabic text, check a reliable book such as Hisn al-Muslim.

duas.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُوْرُ
duas.tr: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after causing us to die (sleep), and to Him is the resurrection.
In Your name, O Allah, I die (sleep) and I live (wake).

duas.ar: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللّٰهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ
duas.tr: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah; there is no might or power except with Allah.
duas.src: Source: Sunan Abi Dawud, Jami at-Tirmidhi

duas.tr: In the name of Allah (I begin).
duas.src: Source: Sunan Abi Dawud, Jami at-Tirmidhi

duas.ar: اَلْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيْ أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِيْنَ
duas.tr: All praise is for Allah who fed us, gave us drink and made us Muslims.
duas.src: Source: Sunan Abi Dawud, Jami at-Tirmidhi

duas.tr: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.

duas.ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِيْنَ وَإِنَّا إِلٰى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُوْنَ
duas.tr: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could not have subdued it ourselves; and to our Lord we shall surely return.

tasbih-counter.wazaifIntro: Well-known adhkar and Quranic supplications. Their virtue is only what the source states; please do not attribute more to them.

wazaif.ar: لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
wazaif.tr: There is no god but You, glory be to You; truly I have been among the wrongdoers.
wazaif.src: Source: Quran (Al-Anbiya 87). A hadith in Tirmidhi says that when a Muslim makes this dua for anything, Allah answers it.

wazaif.tr: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs.

wazaif.ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ
wazaif.tr: There is no might and no power except with Allah.
wazaif.src: Source: Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim. A hadith calls it one of the treasures of Paradise.

tasbih-counter.howTitle: How to use the tasbeeh counter
how: Tap the big button each time you say the dhikr.
When the target is reached the tool tells you and moves to the next dhikr by itself.
For the after-prayer tasbeeh (SubhanAllah 33, Alhamdulillah 33, Allahu Akbar 34) choose a target of 33. For the third dhikr switch the target to “Free” to count up to 34.

faq.q: How many times should I do tasbeeh?
faq.a: There is no single limit. The after-prayer tasbeeh (33, 33 and 34) is reported in a hadith; other adhkar can be said as much as you are able.
Yes, in your phone's browser. It is erased if you clear the browser's data.

faq.q: What if the keep-screen-awake button does not work?
faq.a: This feature is not available in every browser. In that case, increase the screen timeout in your phone settings.
Each dua has its source written beside it. For peace of mind, confirm it in Hisn al-Muslim or with a scholar.
